title: Catalog controls
responsibility: Edits search, changed-only and ordering choices for a catalog.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.noun
inputs.description: Required lowercase plural entity name used in search labels and placeholder.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.filter
inputs.description: Required bindable filter object whose search, changedOnly and order are updated directly.

outputs.name: ExplorerControls
outputs.description: Search field, changed-only switch and order dropdown populated from supported catalog orders. Does not filter records itself.
